row.evidence: iManage's Control Center help says "we support the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) provisioning standard" and points to a login-only article on syncing users and groups from Azure AD to iManage Work at cloudimanage.com; no plan or price is published.
row.notes: Status changed from none to unknown. The June row ('no native SCIM') rested on a third-party directory, which is not an allowed source, and iManage's own Control Center help now states SCIM provisioning is supported (Azure AD to iManage Work at cloudimanage.com). The SCIM setup article sits on help.imanage.com behind customer login, and iManage publishes no pricing or plan tiers (demo/Contact Sales only), so whether SCIM costs extra cannot be determined. June's '~$50-75/u/mo' estimate had no first-party source and was dropped; the June pricing URL (imanage.com/product/) now returns 404. Other provisioning: DirectorySync Windows service (Active Directory/LDAP), migration or manual creation in Control Center. SSO via SAML or OIDC, self-service in Control Center.

limitations.text: The only SCIM guide referenced (Azure AD to iManage Work at cloudimanage.com) is on help.imanage.com, which redirects to a customer login.

okta.notes: Not in the OIN; iManage's guide has customers create a custom SAML 2.0 app integration in Okta.

entra.notes: The 'Cloud iManage' gallery tutorial covers SSO only and says users must be created with iManage support; iManage separately documents (behind login) a SCIM sync from Azure AD, so Entra provisioning likely exists but could not be verified; row idp.entra left null.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin catalogue not loadable; iManage docs do not mention OneLogin.

fallbacks.other_sync: DirectorySync Windows service synchronizing users from Active Directory/LDAP; migration with CSM; manual creation in Control Center
